g.text: Use the same evaluation rules as catalogue listing:
resolve category/allergen names from Product IDs;
FIXED uses basePrice; COMPONENT_BASED requires PredefinedPizza;
normalize BCK08 component prices to BCK05 Money and sum per size;
use CURRENT stock only and evaluate each size independently.
Inactive sellable Products and configured inactive sizes remain visible,
marked available=false. Zero ordinary stock also means unavailable.
